title: Canonical completed unit and finite direct-image evaluation
statement: For the completed direct image of [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-sources] and normalized Presentation [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation], finiteEvaluationOrdinary is the identity commutation of tower direct image with evaluation. finiteEvaluationSquare is the normalized ExactSquare constructed from K-injective computation, using that evaluation preserves K-injectives and uniqueness of derived functors. completedPushUnit is the actual map of coefficient-unit module sheaves induced by the completed coefficient ring map, constructed with Mathlib unitToPushforwardObjUnit. finitePushUnit applies the single functor and normalized completed direct-image comparison. finitePushComparison composes the inverse evaluation square with the inverse varying comparison. All data is constructed; the square existence theorem is proved.
